stories.title: Russian corvette Merkury
stories.summary: Several people are killed and at least 10 people are injured after the Russian corvette Merkury is struck by a Ukrainian naval drone attack while docked at the port of Benghazi, Libya. The Merkury reportedly capsizes and sinks.
stories.about: Merkury was a Steregushchiy-class corvette of the Russian Navy. The original name for the corvette was Retivy (Ретивый) prior to 2021.

stories.title: Tom Jackson (American football, born 1951)
stories.about: Thomas Louie Jackson, also referred to as "TJ" or "Tommy", was an American football player and sports broadcaster and analyst. He played his entire National Football League (NFL) career as a linebacker for the Denver Broncos from 1973 to 1986. He then worked as an NFL analyst for ESPN from 1987 until his retirement in 2016.
